page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with running head at top centre and page number at top right. At the foot, a signature "H" at centre and a catchword "Inte-" at right. No margin notes.

l.i: Et Tu Domine qui es semper idem Deus in æ-
ternum benedictus, cujus variæ Misericordiæ,
& constantes tamen; Tu veteres nostros & quoti-
dianos defectus, nova usque & recenti benigni-
tate restauras, nec renovatos affectus aspernaris,
iisdem licet verbis prolatos.
Ne destituamur beneficio orationum, quas re-
cte prius meditatas unita Tua fundit Ecclesia.
Sit Precum nostrarum Argumentum volun-
tati tuæ conforme, quæ semper eadem, & sug-
gestionibus tui Sancti Spiritus, animorum fervor-
Et jam nulli dubitamus, Te qui tota es Spiri-
tualis perfectio nec affectata Novitate delectar-
nec iisdem sæpe repetitis, piis modo precibus of-i
fenai.
Has enim varias esse, vel easdem, nullibi à
Te vel præceptum vel vetitum: sed relictum
pictati & prudentiæ Ecclesiæ, cui utrisque ha-
rum uti licet, neutram spernere.
Fac ut in Re Religionis ita discant homines
judicia sua pie moderari, ut nec aliis ignorantia
sua noceant, nec facultatem suarum præsidentia
iis omnibus quærant privare, quæ rite simul &
pie in Infirmitatis subsidium adhibentur.
Et cum Errores fere inducant Novitas & Di-
versitas, Veritas contra in unione, & Constan-
tia servatur, Ne Ecclesiam tuam sineris vel cor-
rumpi erroribus, vel indecoris in te colendo riti-
bus deformari à diversa & nova invehentibus [?]:
sed nec etiam fraudari veritate, unione & ordi-
ne, hac fallaci sententia deceptos, statas nempe
has Formas Formam tantum Religionis generare.

page.notes: Running head is Greek, set in capitals: ΕΙΚΩΝ ΒΑΣΙΛΙΚΗ. Doubtful readings: "of-i" and "fenai." at the end of a broken word, read as printed but not certain. "delectar-" at a line end followed by "nec", joined as printed; the word may be incomplete in the scan. "invehentibus" is marked [?] because the ligature in "inuchentibus" is unclear. "relictum" has a long-s-like ligature in "ct" that I read as ct. Body text is set in italic throughout.
